cl.x: Provide Davco Davelastic where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2022, Version 01.01).
A concentrated tile adhesive additive designed to increase flexibility, strength and water resistance of cement-based products.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Suitable for interior and exterior applications. Davco Davelastic being an acrylic polymer creates water resistance in mortars, which enables them to be used in wet areas including concrete swimming pools, spas and external façades.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2022, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
s: All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and relevant Australian Standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean and free from movement, oil, grease, wax, sealers, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose or contaminating material. Thoroughly clean old surfaces, or new surfaces that have been treated, prior to tiling
Deeply contaminated surfaces must be scabbled / abraded to a clean, sound surface; Expose at least 80% of the original substrate of painted surfaces
Surfaces should be prepared and primed in accordance to the relevant tile adhesive product datasheet

cl.x: Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2022, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Recommended dosage
cl.x: Davelastic must be diluted with clean, potable water at a ratio of 1 to 1 for use as an additive in cement based tile adhesives. Thoroughly mix the required amount of Davelastic and water together prior to mixing with the adhesive.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application > Tile Adhesive Mix Process
cl.l: 1. Add the required amount of Davco Davelastic and water mixture into a clean bucket. 2. Slowly add the powder to the liquid while mixing with a mixing paddle attached to a drill. Always add the powder to the liquid. Do not mix by hand. + 3. Continue to mix for several minutes until a creamy consistency is achieved, free of lumps of powder. 4. Allow mixture to stand for 5 minutes, remix then use the adhesive.
s: The tile adhesive should be applied as per the instructions for the adhesive, including all surface preparation Note: Davco Davelastic will increase the tackiness of the adhesive as well as reduce the pot life, open time and adjustment time.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Tools
cl.x: Tools and equipement can be cleaned prior to setting.

s: Test product in an inconspicuous area first
Over movement joints in the substrate
At a junction between different substrate materials
At fixtures interrupting the tile surface e.g. columns
At internal vertical corners
Around the perimeter of the tiling system
At a maximum of 4.5m centres, in a grid pattern
Movement joints should be kept free from dirt and adhesive droppings
All movement joints can be filled with Davco Elite A Silicone or Sika flexible sealant
tr: It is essential to plan the area to be tiled, with inclusion of movement joints in accordance with the Australian Standard AS3958 “Guide to the Installation of Ceramic Tiles.” Failure to do so may result in drummy or lifting tiles.
